provenance.derivation: Editorial: two of our own 2026.08.1 entries chosen for a large gap on BOTH axes that carry contrast. Lightness 0.268 against 0.838 in OKLCh — a gap of 0.570, the widest in this set — and hues 278 and 84, which are 194 degrees apart and therefore close to opposed. Neither value was adjusted to make the pair work; the pair was found among the entries as published.
provenance.editorialNotes: The lightness gap is doing most of the work and the hue opposition is doing the rest, which is why this is the pair a person can judge in bad light. Two members rather than three on purpose: a third would sit between them and soften exactly what the combination is for.
